title: JUG SIM Buildings Scenario 001 Configuration
description: JSON file configuration for the scenario_001 CLI. Defaults describe runtime behavior; validation does not insert them. Service-side Python validation remains authoritative for URL parsing and filesystem paths. Relative output_root resolves against this configuration file's directory.

output_root.description: Output root; relative to the configuration file. New runs use <output_root>/<FSA>/<run_id>/; existing directories are preserved.

fsa.description: Runtime trims surrounding whitespace and converts to uppercase.

keep_outputs.description: Additional GIS Cities output keys. Runtime trims and deduplicates keys; GIS Cities validates supported key names. A nonempty list requires cleanup_outputs=true (the default).

preparation_enabled.description: Run local LCA preparation after successful uniquification; submission requires separate lca_enabled opt-in.

preparation_measurement_crs.description: Projected metre-based option for future metric processing. Existing metrics are never recomputed by preparation.

preparation_source_crs.description: Explicit independently verified source CRS override. Must agree with existing declarations and requires evidence.

preparation_source_crs_evidence.description: Description/reference of independent source CRS verification; paired with override.

preparation_coordinate_operation.description: Optional QGIS coordinate operation. Unavailable/invalid operations fail; target is fixed to EPSG:4326.

lca_enabled.description: Submit the exact prepared artifact to LCA after successful preparation.

evaluation_provenance_path.description: Optional operator-supplied JSON provenance manifest; relative to configuration file.

serviceUrl.description: HTTP(S) base URL, optionally with a path prefix; no credentials, whitespace, query, or fragment. Runtime also validates hostname and port.

positiveTimeout.description: Positive finite seconds. Read timeouts measure socket inactivity, not a total run deadline.
